name: @rbtv/browse
description: Dependency manifest for the browse component — the browser CLIs the environment must provide. Declaration only; never published, never installed in place. `defuddle` is NOT here: it moved to the web/capture component with the reading job (owner-ruled 2026-08-21). See concepts/dependency-manifest.md in the system-definition registry.

install.node: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
install.playwright: npm install --global --prefix "${RBTV_BIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.local}" playwright && playwright install chromium
